title: 3.3 Vectors in the Plane

icans: I can write the component form of a vector and find its magnitude.
I can add, subtract, and multiply vectors by scalars, and find unit vectors.
I can use direction angles to write vectors and solve real-life problems.

vocab: a quantity with ____________ and direction, shown as a directed line segment PQ (initial point P, terminal point Q)
the angle θ from the ___________ x-axis: v = ‖v‖⟨cos θ, sin θ⟩

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Component form: The component form of the vector from P(p₁, p₂) to Q(q₁, q₂) is _______________.

blocks.stem: Find the component form and magnitude of the vector with initial point P(4, −7) and terminal point Q(−1, 5).

Let u = ⟨−2, 5⟩ and v = ⟨3, 4⟩. Find each vector.
a.  2v        b.  u + v        c.  v − u        d.  2u + 3v

notes: Unit vector: A unit vector in the direction of v is _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the magnitude and direction angle of each vector.
a.  u = 3i + 3j        b.  v = 3i − 4j
Let u = ⟨4, −1⟩ and v = ⟨−2, 3⟩. Find 3u − v and its magnitude.

tickets.stem: Find the component form and magnitude of the vector from (2, 3) to (7, −9).
Find a unit vector in the direction of ⟨6, 8⟩.
